name: ai-hedge-fund
readme_excerpt: AI Hedge Fund This is a proof of concept for an AI-powered hedge fund. The goal of this project is to explore the use of AI to make trading decisions. This project is for educational purposes only and is not intended for real trading or investment. > 🚧 The project is evolving. We're rebuilding it into a persistent, always-on AI hedge fund — a fund as a first-class entity you can backtest, paper-trade, and (opt-in) run live, with the investor agents reimagined as pluggable, backtestable "alpha…
